:PAD12.LHRKEBA.MAINTROL ENGINEER   
	HI TBJ REF SEAT 9F
	FIRST OPTION WOULD BE TO RESET SEAT FROM IFE STATION
	1. TOUCH THE SEATS BUTTON IN THE MAIN MENU.
	2. SELECT THE SEAT RESET TAB.
	3. SELECT ONE OR MORE SEATS USING EITHER THE KEYBOARD OR THE L
	OPA METHOD.
	4. WHEN A VALID SEAT NUMBER OR NUMBERS ARE ENTERED THE RESET B
	UTTON BECOMES ACTIVE. TOUCH RESET.
	5. A POPUP MENU APPEARS RESET CHOICES. ALWAYS START WITH A QUI
	CK RESET. TOUCH QUICK TO SELECT THE QUICK RESET FROM THE DROP-
	DOWN MENU.
	6. TOUCH OK TO INITIATE THE RESET. THE QUICK RESET WILL TAKE A
	PPROXIMATELY ONE MINUTE.
	7. WHEN THE RESET IS COMPLETE
	 THE NEXT PROMPT DISPLAYS. TOUCH NEXT TO CONTINUE.
	8. THE SYSTEM PROMPTS QUICK RESET COMPLETE. ISSUE RESOLVED  TO
	UCH NO TO CONTINUE THE SEAT RESET PROCESS.
	PT2
	9. TOUCH YES TO PERFORM ANOTHER RESET.
	10. SELECT FULL FROM THE POP-UP MENU TO PERFORM A FULL SEAT RE
	SET. A STATUS INDICATOR DISPLAYS. WHEN THE FULL RESET IS COMPL
	ETE. VERIFY THAT INTERACTIVE ENTERTAINMENT IS WORKING NORMALLY
	 AT THE PASSENGERS SEAT.
	HOPE THIS HELPS LET US KNOW IF NO JOY AND WE WILL ADVISE
	REGARDS MAINTROL
	SENT 0425Z/08
